title: Recipe for sugar-agar food source for drosophila
author: Katy M Monteith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j6fcrbn

steps.title: Boil distilled water
steps.instruction: Bring 1 litre of triple distilled H₂O to boil in a pan.

steps.title: Add agar and sugar
steps.instruction: Add 20g of agar and 84g of light brown soft sugar to the boiling water.

substeps.instruction: Stir continuously for 5 minutes while the mixture boils rapidly.

steps.title: Add anti-fungal solution
steps.instruction: Allow the mixture to cool to approximately 70°C, then stir in 7ml of tegosept anti-fungal solution.

substeps.instruction: Prepare tegosept by dissolving Methyl-4-hydroxybenzoate in 95% Ethanol at 150g/L.
